question: Which river is known as the sorrow of Bihar?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kosi**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The river **Kosi** is known as the "sorrow of Bihar" due to its frequent and devastating floods.
 
• It is one of the major tributaries of the Ganges, flowing through Nepal and the Indian state of Bihar.
